title: ticfac findings in the run's checkout ends the run: the per-run peek ref is shared across processes
body: runstate.Store fetches into refs/ticfac/peek/<run-id> (store.go:295,337), and `ticfac findings`, `finding` and `settle` open a store with the same run id in the same checkout. Two fetches racing on that ref's lock make the loser exit 1 ('cannot lock ref'), and the reconciler's store.Fetch error ends Run. Reproduced end to end: the fixture epic with a concurrent findings loop failed 2/4 and 2/3 runs; git fetch and git log alone passed 4/4. Violates 9pd A1. Fix: a per-process peek ref, or a lock failure treated as retryable, applied to the tracker's and git.go's private refs too.
